One Day on Earth is an atlas of the news of Tuesday 24 November 2026: a single world map in which twelve lead stories sit in callouts beside numbered red pins, and 24 more stories, numbered to black pins, run below by region. All 36 stories across six continents come from Al Jazeera's reports of that day and Wikipedia's Current events portal (see [design/sources.md](design/sources.md)).

![One Day on Earth, 24 November 2026](entry.png)

## Run it

```sh
mkdir -p out && MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR=out node main.ts
```

`main.ts` (Node 22, standard library only, no network) checks `entry.png` against the gate (PNG signature, whole file through IEND, at most 1024×1024 and 1 MiB) and copies it to `${MAKEFUN_OUTPUT_DIR:-/output}/entry.png`. To rebuild the image, run `design/render.sh` (Node plus headless Chrome): it writes `design/atlas.html` from `design/build.mjs` and screenshots it at 1024×1024. Map outlines come from Natural Earth via [world-atlas](https://github.com/topojson/world-atlas) (ISC).
